faqs.q: Do you handle the insurance paperwork?
faqs.a: Yes. We file the claim, coordinate with your adjuster, and bill the carrier directly. You drop off the vehicle and pick it up when it is ready. Zero calls to the insurance company on your end.

faqs.q: How long does a typical repair take?
faqs.a: Most standard collision repairs take 3 to 8 business days. Frame work or full repaints can run 10 to 14 days. We give you a timeline in writing before any work starts, and we call if anything changes.
Yes. Drive in during business hours or send photos online. We write a detailed, itemized estimate at no charge. No appointment required for in-person estimates.

faqs.q: What does the lifetime warranty cover?
faqs.a: Every repair is backed by a written lifetime workmanship warranty for as long as you own the vehicle. If anything we repaired fails, we fix it at no charge. The warranty transfers if you sell the car.

faqs.q: Can I pay cash instead of going through insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We do out-of-pocket repairs at flat pricing. You see the full cost before we start. Many customers go this route for minor cosmetic work like bumper scrapes or parking lot dings.
We coordinate with Enterprise for rental pickup on the day you drop off your vehicle. If your policy covers a rental, we help get that set up during your first visit.

faqs.q: Will my factory warranty stay valid after repair?
faqs.a: Yes. We use OEM or OEM-equivalent parts and follow manufacturer repair procedures. A certified collision repair does not void your factory warranty under the Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act.
